newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber barely changed at noon.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber barely changed at noon.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were barely changed at midday with a market holiday in Tokyo and sluggish consumer demand continuing to affect sentiment.
Dealers said business was slow with market expecting few inquiries from Asia buyers, like South Kore and China.
"The market looks bearish and prices are just moving downwards in the absence of keen buying," a dealer at a trading firm said.
May RSS Ones buyer and May SMR 20 buyer both eased half a cent each at 277.50 cents ($1.10) and 261.50 cents respectively.
Trading houses offered SMR CV at 332 cents, SMR L at 310 cents, SMR 5 at 256, SMR 10 at 257 and drum latex at 228 cents.
Dealers said supply is gradually flowing into the market as the wintering period is almost over.
"This may affect prices further as there is more rubber stocks and demand is not there," he added.
